features.text: An outer barrel has a cylindrical connecting end and a conical tip end.
features.zh: 笔杆具有圆柱形连接端和锥形笔尖端。

features.text: An ink reservoir tube with a ballpoint moves axially when a cap is rotated, extending or retracting the writing tip.
features.zh: 转动笔帽，使带圆珠笔尖的储墨管沿轴向伸出或缩回。

features.text: An externally threaded hollow rod engages a tapped hole of an intermediate tube to convert rotation into limited axial movement.
features.zh: 空心杆外螺纹配合中间管的螺纹孔，将旋转变成有限轴向位移。

features.text: A compression spring biases a non-rotatable annular engaging member into contact with a rotatable annular engaging member.
features.zh: 压缩弹簧使固定环形啮合件压向旋转环形啮合件。

features.text: The fixed and rotatable engaging members have annular crowns of teeth.
features.zh: 固定和旋转啮合件具有环形齿冠。

features.text: The annular tooth crowns of the fixed and rotatable engaging members are made of metal and produce audible clicking when engaging and disengaging.
features.zh: 两环形齿冠采用金属，啮合和脱离时发出可听到的咔嗒声。

mutations.text: A radial pin on the hollow rod slides in a helical groove of the intermediate tube to convert rotation into limited axial movement.
mutations.zh: 把空心杆的螺纹传动改为径向销沿螺旋槽滑动，其余五项保持不变。

mutations.text: A pair of repelling annular permanent magnets biases a non-rotatable annular engaging member into contact with a rotatable annular engaging member, instead of a compression spring.
mutations.zh: 把压缩弹簧偏置改为一对相斥环形永磁体提供偏置，其余五项保持不变。

mutations.text: The annular tooth crowns of the fixed and rotatable engaging members are made of polyoxymethylene (POM) polymer instead of metal and still produce audible clicking when engaging and disengaging.
mutations.zh: 把环形齿冠材料从金属改为聚甲醛（POM），保留齿形与咔嗒反馈，其余五项保持不变。
